pages.text: A soldier still loyal to an empire long fallen, patrolling the drought-scorched hills in packs, having decided that this burning land is already theirs.

You can summon this soldier by ritual, or call these battle-hardened warriors quickly with a $(l:supreme/items/serpon_head_focus)Serpon Head Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Serpon Colonial Soldier with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
